name: MEDPHISATG
description: A medical school based in Guneku. HRH Dr. Fomuki, Fon of Guneku, was honoured for his achievements in medical education at the MEFU–MECUDA joint meeting of August 2026, with MEDPHISATG named as the school based in Guneku.

visits.context: Visited Guneku MEDPHISATG regarding the HRH scholarships for 2026/2027.

spellingConflict: The source material spells this both MEDPHISATG and Medphisatag, and a Fondom Studios feature of 12 September 2026 calls the school Medvisac. The correct form is not established and has not been chosen here.
sourceNote: Recorded 2026-09-01. No accreditation, programme list or qualification is recorded, because none is established in the sources.
routeNote: Covered on /education, where the St Thierry visit is already published. No standalone presentation is generated for it.

achievements.summary: Four best-performing students awarded 50,000 FCFA each following their HND results; three HND graduates interviewed. Director: Prof. Dr. Tah Thierry, as named in the feature.
